summary: Australia localization of Business Central 29. It covers GST, withholding tax (WHT), Business Activity Statements (BAS), ABN and adjustment notes, tax invoices, EFT payments, post-dated checks and AMAS address validation. It answers where these local fields, reports, setup pages and posting changes sit in the code.
overview: The Australian layer adds a large block of tax functionality on top of W1. GST is enabled in General Ledger Setup ("Enable GST (Australia)"). It is posted through extra procedures in the sales and purchase posting codeunits and in prepayment posting, with full-GST handling and additional-reporting-currency (ACY) amounts on lines. BAS is supported by its own setup and calculation pages (page 11600 "BAS Setup", page 11601 "BAS Calculation Sheet", business unit pages), codeunits 11601 "BAS Management" and 11604 "BAS Export", and BAS fields on G/L Entry, VAT Entry and VAT Report Header. Withholding tax has its own posting groups, posting setup, WHT entries, certificates and settlement, driven by codeunit 28040 "WHTManagement" and hooks in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Post Batch and the sales and purchase posting codeunits.
key_points: GST: Enable GST (Australia) in General Ledger Setup, full GST on prepayments, ACY amount fields on sales and purchase lines, GST sales and purchase entry pages, and the Calculate GST Settlement report.
BAS: BAS Setup, calculation sheets, business units for group lodging, XML field setup, BAS Export codeunit, and BAS Doc. No. and Version fields on G/L and VAT entries.
WHT: WHT Business and Product Posting Groups, WHT Posting Setup, Revenue Types, WHT Entry page, Calc. and Post WHT Settlement, and WHT certificate reports.
ABN and adjustment notes: ABN and ABN Division Part No. on company, customer, vendor and contact; Adjustment, BAS Adjustment and Adjustment Applies-to fields on documents and ledger entries.
Tax invoices and tax credit memos: separate number series, posted tax document pages and tax invoice reports for sales and purchases.
Banking: EFT Management, EFT Register, Create EFT File, BSB fields on bank accounts, post-dated checks, deposit slip and bank reconciliation reports.
Addresses and bar codes: counties, AMAS address validation and DPID bar code printing.
Pricing: cost-plus percentage and published price fields on price list lines and sales prices.

areas.what: Core of the localization. It adds GST and WHT posting to Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Post Batch and Post Reverse, with new events. It adds BAS, adjustment and settlement fields on G/L Entry, VAT Entry, Gen. Journal Line and General Ledger Setup, plus the BAS, WHT, tax invoice and post-dated check codeunits, pages and reports.
areas.why: Learn documents GST posting for BAS reporting to the ATO, withholding tax for vendors without an ABN, and adjustment notes for GST credit adjustments.

areas.what: Adds ABN, WHT, adjustment, tax document and ACY fields to vendor, purchase header and line, and posted purchase documents. Purch.-Post, prepayment posting and invoice posting get WHT and GST procedures. Purchases & Payables Setup gains tax invoice number series and WHT options.
areas.why: Learn covers vendor ABN setup, vendors without ABN for WHT, and payment times reporting from vendor ledger entries.

areas.what: Adds WHT, adjustment, sales tax exemption, tax document and ACY fields to customer, sales header and line, and posted sales documents. Sales-Post and prepayment posting handle full GST and WHT. It also adds the AU/NZ Statement report.
areas.why: Learn documents tax invoices, adjustment notes and GST on prepayments.

areas.what: Adds ABN, WHT registration and related fields to Company Information. Adds address handling with counties, post code check and AMAS validation fields on Country/Region. Format Address gets bar code and tax invoice address procedures.
areas.why: Learn describes Australian addresses with DPID bar coding and AMAS validation.

areas.what: Adds EFT: bank account fields, EFT Management, EFT Register and the Transfer EFT Register and Create EFT File reports. It also adds post-dated check fields on bank ledger entries, WHT on bank reconciliation posting, deposit slip, reconciliation and cash flow compare reports, and back-dated aged reports.
areas.why: Learn documents EFT payments to vendors, bank reconciliation, deposit slips and bank cash flow comparison.

areas.what: Adds a WHT Product Posting Group to Item, Item Template and Item Charge. Item Journal Line gets a vendor exchange rate (ACY) field. Item cost management updates cost-plus prices. Stock Card and Stock Movement reports are added.
Adds the BAS Export codeunit, the G/L-BAS permission set and a source code table extension.
Adds bar code management and two bar code reports for checking and batch processing.
Adds Published Price, Cost, Cost-plus % and Discount Amount to price list lines and price worksheet lines, with a procedure that updates unit price by cost-plus percentage.
areas.why: Learn has a page on determining sales price by cost plus percentage.

areas.what: Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets.
Adds a service document management codeunit for APAC and a Service Manager role center page extension.
Adds ABN, Registered, ABN Division Part No. and IRD No. fields to Contact.
areas.why: Learn explains entering ABNs on company, customer, vendor and contact cards.

areas.what: Adds an Australian expense event subscriber codeunit.
Adds a WHT Product Posting Group field to Fixed Asset.
Data Migration Facade Helper gets a procedure that creates a county when needed.
Incoming purchase document pre-mapping can find a vendor by ABN, and has a new event.
Adds a WHT Product Posting Group field to Resource.

issues: Minor: the WHT certificate reports in the code include shared APAC reports with Thai and Philippine variants (WHT PND 1 to 3, WHT Report - PND 53, WHT Certificate TH - Copy, Certificate of Creditable tax). The key point could say that only some of them apply to Australia.
Minor: the Learn pages describe e-invoicing in Peppol PINT A-NZ format and Payment Times Reporting. The narrative leaves them out, which is acceptable because neither appears as country code.

Minor: the narrative could also mention the GST setup fields in Purchases & Payables Setup (GST Prod. Posting Group, Pre-GST Prod. Posting Group) and the settlement exchange rate fields on Currency Exchange Rate and VAT Entry.
